user.title: Add printer
user.description: Enter the address of a network printer that supports IPP.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Add discovered printer
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found {name} at {host}. Add it to Home Assistant?

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the printer. Check the address and that the printer is on.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the printer. Check that it is on.

print_file.name: Print file
print_file.description: Prints a PDF, JPEG or PNG file from a folder Home Assistant is allowed to read.

path.name: File path
path.description: Full path of the file. It must be inside a folder listed in allowlist_external_dirs.

sides.name: Sides
sides.description: One-sided or two-sided. Uses the printer's default setting when empty.

color_mode.name: Color mode
color_mode.description: Color or black and white. Uses the printer's default setting when empty.

page_ranges.name: Pages
page_ranges.description: Pages to print, for example 1-3,5. Prints all pages when empty.

file_too_large.message: The file is too large. You can send at most {max} MB.

unsupported_file_type.message: This file type can't be printed. Send a PDF, JPEG or PNG file.

option_not_supported.message: The printer doesn't support the {option} option.

printer_unavailable.message: Can't reach the printer. Check that it is on and connected.

print_failed.message: Printing failed because of an unexpected printer error.

invalid_request.message: The upload request is not valid.

admin_required.message: Only administrators can print on this printer.

entry_not_loaded.message: This printer is not ready yet.

path_not_allowed.message: Home Assistant is not allowed to read {path}.
